title: mentha × kerneri var. stachyoides
intro: Mentha × kerneri var. stachyoides, commonly known as Kerners mint or Balkan pennyroyal, is a natural hybrid plant of the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include digestive aid, antispasmodic effects, and its ability to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × kerneri var. stachyoides include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating wounds, reducing pain, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, such as menthone, limonene, and β-pinene, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
